answer: Give each agent a single settlement vertex whose voting weight can grow only from work paid by already-weighted peers. Every inbound payment must pass a prism of independent checks: distinct payer keys, non-reusable collateral, and a cooling interval no clone can share. When a nebula of new accounts reuses the same sponsor, timing, or phrasing, collapse them into that one vertex and slash the cluster bond, so minting extra keys cannot multiply influence.
